column3: BSB adds “Let us fix our eyes.”
BSB adds “and lose heart” for “fainting in your souls.”
BSB supplies “Our fathers” and “God disciplines us.”
BSB renders “peaceable fruit of righteousness” as “a harvest of righteousness and peace.”
BSB supplies “a mountain,” a word found in the Textus Receptus but not in the critical text.
BSB follows the critical text without “or shot with an arrow,” which the Textus Receptus adds.
BSB moves “in joyful assembly” into verse 23.
BSB begins the verse with “in joyful assembly” from verse 22 and adds “You have come.”
BSB renders “let us have grace” as “let us be filled with gratitude.”
